headline: 68 contracts catalogued across Plume, Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Solana (11 EVM vaults × multi-chain + 9 common + 8 Solana OFT programs); admin/role contract addresses identified; no on-chain reads completed due to Plume chain not in DeFiPunkd supported set.

findings.text: D1: Block-explorer name-tag search not attempted for Plume Mainnet (explorer.plume.org) — Plume's explorer is not in the DeFiPunkd or standard EVM supported set and direct fetch was blocked. For Ethereum, contract addresses were sourced from the official docs and confirmed by etherscan.io URLs listed inline on the docs page. BNB Chain addresses are cited from docs with bscscan.com links. Solana addresses cited from docs with solscan.io links. D1 for Plume recorded as unknown due to explorer access block.

D2: Official deployed contracts page found at https://docs.nest.credit/developers/smart-contracts — lists all common EVM contracts (NestVaultPredicateProxy, NestCCTPRelayer, RolesAuthority, NestShareSeizer, NestRedeemOperator, OperatorRegistry, NestAdapter, NestBundler, NestUnlooper) and 11 vault families (nTBILL, nALPHA, nBASIS, nOPAL, nCREDIT, nWISDOM, nACRDX, nLCRD, nFXCF, nCLOA, nAXI) each with share token, NestVault (USDC/pUSD/USDT), plus Solana OFT contracts. Total 68+ contract instances extracted.

D3: Audit page at https://docs.nest.credit/security-and-compliance/audits/ lists 3 Cantina audits for Nest Vault stack (2026-04-10, 2026-01-07×2) in the plumenetwork/nest-protocol GitHub repo, plus 5 legacy BoringVault audits (0xMacro ×2, Spearbit, Pashov ×2) from Ion-Protocol/nucleus-boring-vault. The pinned audit links (slowmist.pdf, slowmist2.pdf) from plumenetwork/contracts/staking/audit are for Plume staking contracts, not Nest vault contracts — fetched GitHub page confirmed this is the staking subdirectory, no Nest-specific addresses in scope. Slowmist audit scope recorded as audit-era staking contracts only.

D4: GitHub repo for Nest is plumenetwork/nest-protocol (sourced from security policy page link). Direct fetch of github.com/plumenetwork/nest-protocol was blocked (403). Audit PDFs are stored at https://github.com/plumenetwork/nest-protocol/blob/main/audits/. No deployment artifact (run-latest.json, deployments.json) could be fetched this run. All addresses sourced from docs D2 page instead.

D5: Multi-chain enumeration completed. Plume Mainnet: 9 common + 11 vault share tokens + 11 USDC NestVaults + 11 pUSD NestVaults + 8 NestVaultComposer = 50+ Plume contracts all catalogued from docs. Ethereum: 9 common + 11 share tokens + 11 USDC NestVaults + select USDT/BNB NestVaults. BNB Chain: NestVaultPredicateProxy, RolesAuthority, NestShareSeizer, NestRedeemOperator, OperatorRegistry plus per-vault share tokens and USDT NestVaults. Solana: 8 OFT mint accounts + 8 OFT store accounts + 8 NestVaultComposer (EVM-side Plume addresses). No missing chains — Plume Mainnet, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana all enumerated.

D6: No factory pattern identified; Nest uses individually deployed vault contracts per asset, not a factory. OperatorRegistry (0xFAbD98aEe7F100ff31632B5d8124488a39a26835) is an operator registry but enumeration via read API was not possible (Plume chainId 98866 not in DeFiPunkd supported set; Ethereum instance not confirmed as having enumerable operators). Recorded in unknowns.

D7: Role taxonomy applied. RolesAuthority (0x93786916e1EE5913A45662a5986559f5785a5BA4) is the primary admin/access-control contract deployed on Plume, Ethereum, and BNB Chain — actor_class unknown (bytecode not read). NestShareSeizer (0xf6c00A6aC137680A5e9ECC7aB342dF2c4D190510) is a guardian-class contract with share seizure capability. NestRedeemOperator (0xD9B432376cB18c99716865e540bb32c67d795440) is an operator. OperatorRegistry (0xFAbD98aEe7F100ff31632B5d8124488a39a26835) governs operator allowlisting. All other vault contracts classified as vault or token roles.
D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace directly to https://docs.nest.credit/developers/smart-contracts/ (fetched this run). No snippet-only sightings promoted to admin_addresses[].

rationale.verdict: Walked official docs (deployed contracts page, audits page, security policy), website, and GitHub page (blocked). Catalogued 9 common EVM contracts + 11 vault share tokens + 44 NestVault instances across Plume/ETH/BNB + 8 Solana OFT pairs + 8 NestVaultComposer (Plume-side) = 80 contract instances total; admin/control surface concentrated on RolesAuthority, NestShareSeizer, OperatorRegistry deployed identically across chains. No on-chain reads completed (Plume not in DeFiPunkd supported chainId set; Ethereum reads not performed due to fetch quota).

Official deployed contracts page: lists all common EVM contracts (NestVaultPredicateProxy 0xfc0c4222b3a0c9b060c0b959dec62442036b9035, NestCCTPRelayer 0x7de01896d36Bea9CF072Ac64E41685418941d8bE, RolesAuthority 0x93786916e1EE5913A45662a5986559f5785a5BA4, NestShareSeizer 0xf6c00A6aC137680A5e9ECC7aB342dF2c4D190510, NestRedeemOperator 0xD9B432376cB18c99716865e540bb32c67d795440, OperatorRegistry 0xFAbD98aEe7F100ff31632B5d8124488a39a26835, NestAdapter 0x2De3ECaba30C3AE5f12d19A70064F73538a113ea, NestBundler 0x09A21713265D80Da0ad088f903F6Fc47054Cd6dd, NestUnlooper 0xB7e21EcEc8cA083AcEfb465048EDc604328d392A) and all 11 vault families with share tokens and NestVault addresses per chain, plus Solana OFT contracts.

Audit history: 3 Cantina audits (2026-04-10, 2026-01-07 x2) for Nest vault stack in plumenetwork/nest-protocol repo; 5 legacy BoringVault audits (0xMacro x2, Spearbit, Pashov x2) in Ion-Protocol/nucleus-boring-vault repo. No contract addresses in scope tables visible in this doc page.
Security contact is security@plume.org; canonical repo is github.com/plumenetwork/nest-protocol; no bug bounty platform (Immunefi etc.) linked — private disclosure via email only.

GitHub page for slowmist.pdf confirms it is in the plumenetwork/contracts staking/audit directory — this audit covers Plume staking contracts, not Nest vault contracts. No Nest-specific addresses visible in page metadata.

protocol_metadata.about: Nest (by Plume) is a non-custodial RWA yield protocol that lets users deposit stablecoins (USDC, pUSD, USDT) into ERC-4626/ERC-7540 vaults and receive liquid vault receipt tokens (e.g. nTBILL, nALPHA, nBASIS) representing proportional shares of curated institutional-grade real-world assets. Each vault bundles assets such as U.S. Treasuries, private credit, CLOs, and ETFs sourced from regulated fund managers including BlackRock, Blackstone, Apollo, and WisdomTree. Vaults are built on the Nucleus BoringVault architecture (now migrated to Nest-native contracts), deployed across Plume Mainnet, Ethereum, and BNB Chain, with Solana access via LayerZero OFT cross-chain bridges. The protocol is created and managed by the Plume Foundation (Kimber Labs Inc.) and incorporates AML/compliance screening via Predicate before vault entry.
